items.title: 17.11 RL series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through an RL series circuit (PDF 100-102).

blocks.text: Resistor R aur inductor L AC source V ke saath series mein hain (Fig 17.10 a), is liye dono se aik hi current I = Io sin(theta) guzarta hai. R par rms voltage VR = Irms R, current ke saath in phase (Fig 17.10 c mein lakeer OA). L par rms voltage VL = Irms XL, current se 90 darje aage (lakeer OB). Nateeja voltage V un ka vector jor hai (lakeer OP): Vrms = (VR^2 + VL^2) ka square root = Irms x (R^2 + (wL)^2) ka square root. Is liye impedance Z = Vrms / Irms = (R^2 + (wL)^2) ka square root (17.23), aur phase zawiya theta = tan^-1(wL/R). Yahan voltage current se theta aage hai (Fig 17.10 b).

Kharch taqat resistor ki wajah se hai, kyunke inductor tawanai jama karta lekin misali taur par zaya nahi karta: P = I^2 R = VI cos(theta). Factor cos(theta) power factor kehlata hai. Jab DC taqat (maslan solar panels se) inverter se AC taqat mein badli jaye to inverter ki kaarkardagi, aam taur par 85 se 90 feesad, shamil karni parti hai: Pac = (inverter ki kaarkardagi) x Pdc.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq 1.5 ton ka air conditioner fi ghanta taqreeban 1.2 se 1.5 unit (kWh) bijli kharch karta hai. Yeh bhi batati hai ke bijli wali eel machhliyan teen aza se taqatwar jhatke deti hain jo eel ki lambai ka taqreeban 80 feesad hain aur electrocytes naam ke khaas cells se bane hain.

blocks.prompt: 575 W (DC) wale solar panel se 75 feesad kaarkardagi wale inverter ke zariye kitni AC taqat milegi?
30 ohm resistance aur 40 ohm inductive reactance wali coil 100 V rms supply se juri hai. Is ki impedance, current aur power factor maloom karein.
blocks.explanation: Z = (30^2 + 40^2) ka square root = 50 ohm; Irms = 100/50 = 2 A; cos(theta) = R/Z = 0.6 (theta = 53 darje, voltage aage).

items: RL series: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (wL)^2); voltage current se theta = tan^-1(wL/R) aage.
P = I^2 R = VI cos(theta); cos(theta) power factor.
Pac = inverter ki kaarkardagi x Pdc.
